os-terminal-files-001.title: Create files and set permissions
os-terminal-files-001.instructions: In your terminal, create a directory named `project`, create `hello.txt` inside it with the exact content `Hello World` followed by a newline, and set the file mode to `644`. You may use any valid command sequence that produces the required final state.
hints: Use mkdir to create the directory.
Use echo "Hello World" > project/hello.txt; echo automatically appends one newline.
Use chmod to set the file permissions.

checks.description: hello.txt contains the exact required text.

terminal.explanation: The correction checks the final directory, file contents, and permission bits. Different command sequences receive the same result when their final filesystem state matches.

os-terminal-file-ops-002.title: Move, copy, rename and remove existing files
os-terminal-file-ops-002.instructions: The starting environment is already prepared with files in `inbox/` and `work/`. Move `brief.txt` from `inbox/` into `work/`, copy `checklist.txt` into `work/copies/` while keeping the original, rename `draft-plan.txt` to `final-plan.txt`, remove `delete-me.tmp`, and set `work/brief.txt` to permission mode `640`. Do not recreate the starting files: practise operating on the files that are already there.
hints: Use `mv SOURCE DEST` to move a file or rename it.
Use `cp SOURCE DEST` to copy a file and keep the original.
Use `rm` to remove the temporary file.
Use `chmod 640 work/brief.txt` to set the required permission bits.

preSetupCommands: printf 'Keep this brief\nIt starts in the inbox.\n' > /home/student/inbox/brief.txt
printf 'Draft plan\nMove this file and rename it.\n' > /home/student/work/draft-plan.txt
printf 'This temporary file should be removed.\n' > /home/student/inbox/delete-me.tmp

checks.description: The original brief.txt path is now empty.

checks.expected:
Keep this brief
It starts in the inbox.
checks.description: The moved brief keeps its original multiline contents.
The moved brief has permission mode 640.
A copy of checklist.txt exists in work/copies/.
The original checklist.txt remains in inbox/.
The old draft-plan.txt name no longer exists.

terminal.explanation: The initial files are prepared by preSetupCommands before the student shell starts. Resetting the exercise runs those setup commands again, restoring the original starting state. Grading inspects the resulting virtual filesystem, not command history.
